name: ent
description: Datenpaket für HNO: Audio-Exposition, Halsschmerzen, Schwindel, Schnarchen
description_en: Data package for ENT: audio exposure, sore throat, dizziness, snoring

queries.ent_symptoms: SELECT date, symptom, value_num, value_text FROM symptoms WHERE person = :person AND (symptom LIKE '%runny_nose%' OR symptom LIKE '%sinus%' OR symptom LIKE '%sore_throat%' OR symptom LIKE '%hals%' OR symptom LIKE '%loss_of_smell%' OR symptom LIKE '%loss_of_taste%' OR symptom LIKE '%dizziness%' OR symptom LIKE '%Schwindel%') AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
queries.audio_exposure: SELECT ts, date, value, unit, metric, source_app FROM measurements WHERE metric IN ('audio_exposure_env','audio_exposure_headphone') AND person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.body_temperature: SELECT ts, date, value FROM measurements WHERE metric='body_temperature' AND person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY ts
queries.snoring: SELECT date, source_app, snore_s, body_temp_dev FROM sleep WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to AND snore_s IS NOT NULL ORDER BY date
queries.migraine: SELECT date, severity, duration_h, aura, photophobia FROM migraine WHERE person = :person AND date BETWEEN :date_from AND :date_to ORDER BY date
